verdict.rationale: Evidence mentions the Intel Xe Media Engine enabling simultaneous play/stream/edit with 'sharp, high-def video' and Arc graphics for editing/exports, implying hardware media encode/decode capability, but no documentation specifies codec support (AV1, HEVC, ProRes) or explicit encode/decode hardware specs. missing for 10: explicit codec-level documentation (AV1/HEVC/ProRes encode-decode specs), independent benchmark corroboration of hardware media engine performance.
